sites.name: Tikal National Park
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Maya city in Petén, 63 km from Flores per the ministry page.

access.opening: Daily 06:00 to 18:00; sunrise tour 04:00 to 06:00 and sunset tour 18:00 to 20:00.
access.tickets: Foreigners Q150, nationals Q25; sunrise or sunset tour Q100 for foreigners on top of regular entry; museums Q30. No RBA rate for GTQ.
access.permits: An authorised guide is compulsory for sunrise and sunset tours, hired by the visitor; daytime visits can be self-guided.

laws.rule: Tikal sunrise and sunset tours need regular entry, the tour ticket and an authorised guide; do not feed wildlife or climb structures not enabled for it.

Tikal: the official FAQ requires the Forma 63A2 ticket PDF, printed or legible on a device, and valid identification. A payment receipt or bank screenshot is not the admission ticket. Choose the foreign-visitor category if applicable. Unused tickets can be presented within 30 days after purchase; once validated they are consumed and apply only to that visit day. Sunrise/sunset tours require BOTH general admission and the specific tour ticket, plus an INGUAT-authorised guide arranged separately; the platform does not provide the guide.
